User acceptance testing: order coordinator pack, Larkspur Ceramics

What this test is

You try the finished build against what was agreed, using the scenarios below. A problem inside the agreed scope is fixed quickly and at no charge; anything new is written down and priced before any work starts.

Dates

  • Session 1: Thursday 7 January 2027
  • Session 2: Tuesday 12 January 2027
  • Session 3: Thursday 21 January 2027 (the final confirmation run)

Signing in

Your login comes from the operations manager. Your tester id is oc-T1; write it in the results template instead of your name.

Your scenarios

ScenarioWhat to doWhat you should see
SC-01Ten September purchase orders reach the order sheetEach order's lines appear in the order sheet within 15 minutes, with the product codes in the LC-nnnn form, and nobody retypes them. All 10 arrive with every line correct (10 cases).
SC-02An email with no readable purchase order goes to the exceptions listBoth emails are on the exceptions list with the reason, and nothing is written to the order sheet (2 cases).
SC-03A line with an unknown code stops on the exceptions listEach altered line is on the exceptions list with the code and the customer, and not in the order sheet (3 cases).
SC-05Every product code is in the LC-nnnn form after the clean-upAll 60 sampled codes are in the LC-nnnn form (60 cases).
SC-10Settle the morning's exceptions listEvery line on the list is settled and moves to the order sheet or is marked for the customer (1 case).

Reporting a problem

Write down what you did, what you expected and what happened. Add a screenshot only if it shows no real customer data. Send it to the operations manager.

The results template

Fill one row per scenario in results-template.csv: tester id, scenario, result (pass, fail, blocked or not run), cases passed, note, records created. There is no name column.
